services.title: Interior & Exterior Finishing
services.metaTitle: Interior & Exterior Finishing Port Harcourt | Mercury Décor
services.summary: Explore painting, wall screeding, tiling, marble-effect finishes, decorative wall panels and stamped flooring for residential and commercial spaces in Port Harcourt.
services.intro: The finish is what people see and touch every day. Mercury Décor Limited works with clients to define suitable surface treatments for the room, the building and the way it will be used.
services.details: Our finishing scope includes painting, wall screeding, tiling, marble-effect and graze finishes, 3D wall panels and stamped flooring. Discuss the condition of the surface, the intended look and the practical requirements before requesting a quotation.

services.intro: Ceilings influence the proportion and light of an interior. A useful brief starts with room dimensions, desired forms and the lighting layout, not only a reference photo.
services.details: Mercury Décor's total finishing work covers POP ceilings, plasterboard ceilings, skim ceilings and decorative ceiling designs. Browse real ceiling examples in the catalog to compare layered profiles, recessed details and integrated lighting.

projects.title: Rumuigbo Palace Interior Finishing
projects.summary: Interior view identified as part of Rivers State Government projects at Eze Oha Apara, Rumuigbo Palace, Port Harcourt.
projects.detail: The photograph shows a furnished interior with a decorative ceiling, lighting and coordinated room finishes.
projects.consideration: Notice how the ceiling treatment, pendant lighting and wall colour work together around the furniture. When discussing a similar interior, consider which elements will remain in the room and whether the planned lighting suits its layout.

projects.title: Rumuigbo Palace Exterior
projects.summary: Exterior view identified as part of Rivers State Government projects at Eze Oha Apara, Rumuigbo Palace, Port Harcourt.
projects.detail: The image shows a finished building exterior, roofline and central entrance feature.
projects.consideration: The facade has a strong central axis, with the entrance framed against a broader roofline. For your own exterior, share the elevation and roof details so the proposed finish can be considered across the whole building rather than in isolation.

projects.title: Residential Ceiling Lighting
projects.summary: A residential interior showing recessed ceiling lighting and finished room surfaces.
projects.detail: This reference shows how a recessed ceiling and lighting layout can contribute to the appearance of a completed room.
projects.consideration: Look at the distance between the ceiling edges, central fixture and recessed downlights. The placement that works in one room may not work in another; ceiling height and the location of furniture are useful details to discuss before selecting a layout.

projects.title: White Building Exterior & Roofline
projects.summary: A completed white building exterior with dark roofing and a defined entrance.
projects.detail: The contrast between the light facade and dark roof is the main visual feature in this exterior reference.
projects.consideration: Here the dark roof edge outlines the pale exterior and makes the entrance easier to read. If you are planning an exterior treatment, consider the relationship between roof colour, trim, windows and the finish already on the walls.

projects.title: Decorative Steel Carport Canopy
projects.summary: A residential carport with a decorative black steel canopy.
projects.detail: The canopy frame provides a clear reference for the relationship between metalwork, driveway and property exterior.
projects.consideration: The visible frame and decorative elements give the carport its character without hiding the driveway beneath. For a similar brief, discuss available clearance, vehicle movement and the existing architecture before deciding on the frame proportions.

projects.title: Ornamental Stair Railing
projects.summary: A wrought-iron stair railing with a decorative scroll motif.
projects.detail: The image highlights the rail profile and scrollwork that shape the look of the stairway.
projects.consideration: The repeated scrolls form a pattern along the stair run while the handrail follows its slope. For your own stairway, accurate measurements, the landing arrangement and the required handrail height are more useful than a style reference alone.

projects.title: Stamped Concrete Patio Finish
projects.summary: A terracotta stamped-concrete patio with a patterned surface.
projects.detail: The reference focuses on the repeating paving texture and colour across the finished outdoor floor.
projects.consideration: The consistent pattern gives this outdoor surface a defined visual rhythm. If a patterned finish is being considered, discuss the size of the area, drainage conditions and how the colour will sit against adjoining walls or paving.

projects.title: Stainless & Gold Balcony Railing
projects.summary: A decorative stainless and gold balcony railing overlooking a patterned floor.
projects.detail: This view offers a close look at metallic balusters, handrail detailing and their relationship to the surrounding finish.
projects.consideration: The mixed metallic tones and closely spaced details create a prominent edge to the balcony. Share the balcony measurements and preferred finish when enquiring; the exact dimensions and site conditions will affect what is appropriate.

projects.title: Compass Pattern Decorative Paving
projects.summary: Stamped concrete paving with a multicolour compass pattern.
projects.detail: The central compass motif is the focal point of this decorative paving reference.
projects.consideration: A large central motif needs enough surrounding space to remain visible when vehicles or furniture are present. Think about where the main viewing angle will be and how the border pattern should meet the edges of your own outdoor area.

projects.title: Recessed Ceiling Panel
projects.summary: A white recessed ceiling panel outlined by a black rectangular border.
projects.detail: The sharp border and simple geometry make this a useful reference for restrained ceiling detailing.
projects.consideration: The design relies on a clean contrast between a white plane and a narrow dark outline rather than multiple layers. Consider the room dimensions, whether the panel should align with the space below it and where any lighting will be placed.

projects.title: Illuminated Hallway Ceiling
projects.summary: A contemporary hallway ceiling with warm cove lighting and linear LED strips.
projects.detail: This reference shows the visual effect of combining perimeter lighting with straight illuminated channels.
projects.consideration: The long ceiling lines draw the eye down the passage, while the cove introduces a warmer edge. For a corridor with different proportions, discuss the lighting positions, access for maintenance and the intended brightness before adapting the idea.

projects.title: Layered Ceiling Design
projects.summary: A layered ceiling with black trims, warm lighting and a geometric centrepiece.
projects.detail: The photograph illustrates how layered forms and contrasting trim create a stronger ceiling focal point.
projects.consideration: Several levels of framing lead toward the central detail. This composition will read differently in a smaller room, so share the ceiling height, plan and the positions of existing electrical points when discussing an adapted design.
